checks.rationale: The six local action blocks follow the middle DroNC-Seq route: isolate nuclei, co-encapsulate, lyse/capture, recover beads, make cDNA, sequence. Every State is a supported preparation or data boundary, and each intermediate is reused by its two neighboring operations. The left nucleus/RNA inset and oligo legend are annotations, not extra actions. Free non-polyA RNA stays a component of the lysed preparation; no isolated fraction or retained branch is invented. The sole multi-input block, encapsulate, is a genuine combination shown by the plus sign and droplet. Droplets remain separate through capture and are broken before the common bead preparation. The broad cDNA block legitimately covers library completion without exposing a recipe.
